sloka: बुद्ध्यस्व नृपशार्दूल कुरु कार्यमनन्तरम् ।ब्राह्मणा बलमुख्याश्च नैगमाश्चागता नृप ॥२-१५-२४॥
transliteration: buddhyasva nṛpaśārdūla kuru kāryamanantaram ।brāhmaṇā balamukhyāśca naigamāścāgatā nṛpa ॥2-15-24॥

translations.english: O scion of the Raghu dynasty brahmins, army commanders and merchants have arrived and they beseech your audience. Please awake.
